title: Bachelors of Business Administration
description: Build the skills to lead, manage, and innovate in modern organizations with a dynamic Bachelor’s Degree in Business Administration designed for future business leaders.
longDescription: The Bachelor’s Degree in Business Administration provides a strong foundation in core business principles, preparing students for professional success in diverse industries. The program focuses on developing analytical, managerial, and communication skills essential for modern organizations. Through practical modules, students gain knowledge in finance, operations, leadership, and human resource management. This program equips learners with the competencies required to start, manage, and grow successful businesses.
courseDetails: Demonstrate effective communication skills in professional business environments. Apply customer service strategies to improve customer satisfaction and loyalty. Understand and interpret financial and accounting information for business decisions. Develop and evaluate business ideas from concept to market implementation. Use management accounting techniques to support strategic decision-making. Apply human resource management principles to manage and develop employees. Analyze operational processes to improve efficiency and productivity. Demonstrate leadership skills in managing teams and organizational activities. Evaluate strategic human resource practices that support organizational goals. Integrate business knowledge to solve real-world management challenges. This programme offers a comprehensive understanding of business operations and management practices in today’s competitive environment. Students explore essential areas such as communication, customer service, accounting, entrepreneurship, and strategic management. The course emphasizes real-world application through case studies and practical learning activities. Learners develop decision-making, leadership, and problem-solving skills required for effective business management. The program also highlights the importance of operational efficiency, financial planning, and human resource development. Graduates will be prepared to pursue careers in business management, entrepreneurship, and organizational leadership. By the end of this programme, students will be able to:

entry: For entry into Bachelors in Business Administration, learners must possess the following:
* Relevant/Local Board of Examination Result in your Country, which must include at least 5 'C' Grades in English and 4 other subjects.
* Mock Examination Result can also be accepted for initial Conditional Admission, pending the release of the Board of Examination Result. (This is assessed on a case by case basis)
* Learner must be 18 years or older at the start of the Course.
* Mature Learners (21 years or older) with work experience in supervisory, leadership or management roles. (This is assessed on a case by case basis).
accreditation: All GSS courses are accredited by the relevant partners and awarding bodies. Please refer to GSS accreditation in about us for more details.
progression: University Top-up On completion of this course, students have the opportunity to be awarded with a bachelor's degree programme from the Azteca University.
workshops: Workshops are conducted by live webinars for online students. Classroom workshops are available if there is a local branch in your country. Speak our course advisors on this subject.
visa: There is no Visa requirement for this programme.
gettingStartedIntro: Complete the application, document review, offer, payment and enrolment steps through the learner portal.
